d: Indian tennis legend Vijay Amritraj reflects on his battles against some of the greatest players in the sport, recalling his memorable rivalry with Australian icon Ken Rosewall. Recounting the 1973 US Open quarterfinals, Amritraj shares how his coach and idol Pancho Gonzales repeatedly warned him to avoid Rosewall’s formidable backhand. Describing Gonzales, Amritraj noted, “Pancho Gonzales's serve is arguably the best serve I have ever seen in my life, and he learned it himself.” He also compares Rosewall’s slicing backhand with Ramanathan Krishnan’s majestic technique and Jimmy Connors’…
